changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 6e item 3: ChannelService is now the single owner of the channel lifecycle. It absorbs the runnable-channel shape guard, the best-effort build-failure close helper, the Channel MCP delegate assembly, and the ChannelMetadata type (each from its own former file); the per-session initialize/start loops and the Core-port-lease tracking move here from DispatcherInputSourceLifecycle; the built/live instance maps and the port-lease array unify into one map keyed by channel id; and each channel's provider is now resolved from the catalog at most once instead of once per role. Internal ownership and file-location change only — same Commands, same MCP tool names, same channel.list output shape.

ChannelService.closeAll() now collects and reports every channel session's close failure instead of logging and swallowing it. A Dispatcher's own close already wraps this call in its aggregate shutdown-failure collector, so a channel provider's close() throwing during a dispatcher stop or the daemon's graceful shutdown now surfaces as a shutdown failure where it was previously silent.
